governance_problem: The D0345 frozen direct-parent requirement was satisfied by the effective D0346 implementation freeze. A later corrected implementation cannot automatically inherit that exact requirement or D0346 receipt binding.

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: Any successor must be created under a separately reviewed, committed, published and independently remote-verified prospective authorization. Historical D0345/D0346/D0347 artifacts remain immutable.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Non-retroactive governance transition

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: A future corrected implementation must have an exact recorded Git ancestry and an explicitly authorized effective-freeze predecessor. The old D0345 direct-parent rule must not be silently reused, bypassed or retroactively edited.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Explicit successor commit lineage

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: Address the integer subprocess pipe-FD conflict without introducing an unrestricted FD exemption. Require explicit metadata-subprocess provenance, narrow FD lifecycle control, FIFO validation where applicable, default-deny behavior and preserved subprocess/file allowlists.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Strictly bounded audit-hook correction

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: Preserve D0343 property-path-based F0–F6 regeneration, frozen artifact attestation semantics, D0336 exact matching/output rules and D0344 successor execution ordering. Add only bounded positive/negative synthetic attestation coverage for existing structural checks.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Frozen scientific semantics

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: No new or additional D0345 readiness attempt is granted. Any future transfer or supersession of the remaining single attempt requires explicit successor authorization, unique identity and single-consumption accounting. The original authorization cannot be assumed executable against corrected code.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Single-attempt authorization continuity

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: After a separately authorized corrected freeze becomes effective, create a new authenticated, non-consuming preflight receipt bound to the exact successor commit and implementation SHA-256. The D0346 receipt remains historical evidence and must not be rewritten or reused.
proposed_successor_rules.title: New implementation-specific preflight

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: Preserve all fifteen D0345 check identities, order and scientific-read restrictions unless a future separate explicit amendment precisely authorizes a change. Synthetic vectors cannot be executed ahead of the authorized one-shot consumption boundary.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Readiness scientific firewall

proposed_successor_rules.requirement: Keep authorization, source authoring, static review, freeze commit, postcommit review, GitHub publication, exact remote readback, preflight, receipt review, readiness and ZE2 execution in distinct governed stages.
proposed_successor_rules.title: Separate publication and execution gates
